characters.name: Becky Blasband
characters.description: Singer-Songwriter: She is a folk singer.

characters.name: Heather B. Gardner
characters.description: Conscious Hip Hop: She is an aspiring rapper, and she writes an album called "The System Sucks".

characters.name: Julie Gentry
characters.description: Innocently Insensitive: She grew up in a very sheltered environment, and sometimes says ignorant things, which bothers black roommates Heather and Kevin. Southern Belle: She is from Alabama.

characters.name: Norman Korpi
characters.description: No Bisexuals: Averted, as he is bisexual.

characters.name: Eric Nies
characters.description: Mr. Fanservice: He is a male model, and all the girls find him attractive.

characters.name: Aaron Behle
characters.description: Blonde Republican Sex Kitten: a rare male example, he referred to President Clinton as the "anti-Christ", although he is liberal on other issues. Odd Friendship: with Dominic since they share different political views. Surfer Dude: He is from California and loves to surf.

characters.name: Beth Storalczyk
characters.description: Crazy Cat Lady: She has a cat who she brings with her to the house. Drama Queen: the other roommates referred to her as this.

characters.name: David Edwards
characters.description: Never My Fault: Saw nothing wrong with what he did to Tami, thinking it was just a joke. Politically Incorrect Villain: In addition to sexually harassing Tami, he was often very misogynistic towards women in general. Put on a Bus: He leaves in the seventh episode, after the rest of the house votes to evict him. Recorded and Stand-Up Comedy: He is an aspiring stand-up comic.

characters.name: Dominic Griffin
characters.description: Deadpan Snarker: Often makes snarky comments in the confessional interviews. Delinquent Hair: Has spiky black punk hair. Must Have Nicotine: He describes himself as "severely addicted" to nicotine. Oireland: He is from Dublin and speaks with a thick Irish accent. Odd Friendship: With Aaron due to their different political views.

characters.name: Irene Barrera-Kearns
characters.description: Fair Cop: She works as a deputy sheriff.

characters.name: Jon Brennan
characters.description: Country Music: He is an aspiring country singer, and is a local celebrity in his small town. Deep South: He is from Kentucky, and comes from a very religious Christian family. He experiences culture shock coming to LA and meeting his roommates. He even wears a mullet and a cowboy hat, as Deep South as you can get.

characters.name: Tami Roman
characters.description: R&B: Belongs to an R&B girl group, similar to En Vogue. Sassy Black Woman: She has a big mouth and is not afraid to use it.

characters.name: Glen Naessens
characters.description: Alternative Rock: He sings in an alternative rock band.

characters.name: Jamie Murray
characters.description: Small Name, Big Ego: He thinks he's cooler than he actually is.

characters.name: Melissa Howard
characters.description: Hated Hometown: She dislikes living in Tampa, because there are too many close-minded people there. Not Like Other Girls: She admits she does not get along well with other women, but loves male attention.

characters.name: Danny Roberts
characters.description: Hide Your Gays: dated a man named Paul during the show, who was in the military and had to have his face blurred due to the "Don't Ask, Don't Tell" policy of the time. Straight Gay: He is gay, but doesn't fit many of the stereotypes you might associate.

characters.name: Kelley Limp
characters.description: Everybody Loves Blondes: she is blonde and attractive.

characters.name: Julie Stoffer
characters.description: Innocent Bigot: She sometimes says racist or insensitive things, getting into fights with Melissa over it, but it is largely because of her sheltered background.

characters.name: David Broom
characters.description: Really Gets Around: he loves women. Singer-Songwriter: He is an aspiring singer/songwriter, his biggest song being "Come On Be My Baby Tonight". Small Name, Big Ego: he thinks he is better than his other roommates.

characters.name: Alton Williams
characters.description: Momma's Boy: he describes his mother his best friend. Military Brat: he grew up in a Navy household Politically Incorrect Hero: he has homophobic tendencies, but with a reason: his brother was molested and killed by a gay man, and he was a victim of sexual abuse as well.

characters.name: Arissa Hill
characters.description: Dysfunctional Family: comes from one, and can't stand when they bother her. Hated Hometown: she was raised in the projects of Boston, and says she never wants to go back. Tsundere: of the type A. She gives off a tough exterior, is not afraid to put her guard up if others are bothering her, but deep down, can be sweet and sensitive at times. Weight Woe: she previously struggled with an eating disorder, and worries about Trishelle when she begins to fall down the same path.

characters.name: Brynn Smith
characters.description: A-Cup Angst: said she does not like her small breasts, and is jealous of Trishelle's larger ones. Double Standard: Abuse, Female on Male: Brynn throws a fork at Steven, and pushes him during an argument. Averted however, as he is visibly upset by it and greatly considered sending her home for it, but ultimately decides not to. Family-Friendly Stripper: not a stripper, but she becomes a go-go dancer during the show. Genki Girl: she loves to party, dance, and just have an overall good time. Girl-on-Girl is Hot: made out with Trishelle, and thought it was arousing.

characters.name: Frank Roessler
characters.description: Dogged Nice Guy: he finds Trishelle attractive at first, but was not happy when she first got together with Steven. Satellite Character: has very little personality compared to the rest of his roommates. Did not have many interesting story lines throughout the series revolving around him, and was more defined by his interactions with others. Slut-Shaming: he slut-shames Trishelle after she hooks up with Steven for the first time. Small Town Boredom: from a small town in Pennsylvania, which is overrun byAmish You Need to Get Laid: had a difficult time getting laid in Las Vegas

characters.name: Irulan Wilson
characters.description: Big Applesauce: she is from the Bronx Love Triangle: between Alton, and her boyfriend back home. She can't decide which one she wants.

characters.name: Steven Hill
characters.description: Amicable Exes: Steven and his ex-wife Double Standard: Abuse, Female on Male: Brynn throws a fork at Steven, and pushes him during an argument. Averted however, as he is visibly upset by it and greatly considered sending her home for it, but ultimately decides not to. Fanservice with a Smile: he was a bartender before the show Girl-on-Girl is Hot: admitted to being turned on when Trishelle and Brynn made out in front of him. Have I Mentioned I Am Heterosexual Today?: he works at a gay bar, and often getsMistaken for Gay

characters.name: Trishelle Cannatella
characters.description: Abusive Parents: her parents are both very religious and strict, and her own father even slut-shamed her, despite her being an adult capable of her own decisions. Girl-on-Girl is Hot: she makes out with Brynn, and Steven (her boyfriend) found it attractive. Hard-Drinking Party Girl: she loves to party, but for the most part has it under control I Am Not Pretty: does not believe she's as beautiful as others tell her she is. Missing Mom: her mother died when she was 14.

characters.name: Ace Amerson
characters.description: French Jerk: How he perceives the locals when he first gets to France. Fratbro: He belongs to a fraternity and shows all the stereotypes. Missing Mom: His mother pass three years before the show. Nice Guy: He seems to get along well with everybody Only Known by Their Nickname: Nobody ever refers to him by his real name.

characters.name: Adam King
characters.description: Casanova Wannabe: He tries to find a girlfriend in Paris, but instead only has very short sexual relationships with them. Disappeared Dad: His parents separate during the season. Dogged Nice Guy: How he describes his love life, he has no luck when it comes to women. This is especially shown when he is attracted to Mallory but she does not reciprocate, and he gets angry at her. Entitled to Have You: He sometimes feels this way around women if they don't give him what he wants right away. Sucks at Dancing: He is a terrible dancer, as seen from him dancing in the club.

characters.name: C.T. Tamburello
characters.description: The Berserker: Gets into fights and has anger issues with both his roommates and strangers alike. The Big Guy: Has muscles, isn't afraid to show them off, and isn't afraid to put them to use. Dark and Troubled Past: He is estranged from both his father and younger brother (who is a drug addict). Hollywood New England: He is from Boston, and has a thick accent. Love Letter Lunacy: On Valentine's Day, Leah receives a bouquet of flowers that were sent from a friend back home, which he takes credit for. Drama ensues.

characters.name: Christina Trainor
characters.description: A-Cup Angst: She got breast implants because she did not like her smaller breasts. Fake Boobs: She has breast implants. Fanservice with a Smile: She works as a cocktail waitress in Las Vegas. Military Brat: Her family was in the military growing up.

characters.name: Leah Gillingwater
characters.description: Big Sister Instinct: She didn't want her younger brother to hook up with Mallory, because she knew he would get hurt in the end. Control Freak: Went through altercations with all of her roommates over relatively small issues, typically when someone doesn't do something her way. Dogged Nice Girl: She is initially attracted to Ace, but he does not reciprocate. Adam tells her she has no chance with Ace, which upsets her. Europeans Are Kinky: Meets an Italian boy and begins dating him. She's attracted to him simply for being Italian. Love Letter Lunacy: On Valentine's Day, she receives a bouquet of flowers that were sent from a friend back home, which CT takes credit for. Drama ensues.

characters.name: Mallory Snyder
characters.description: All Women Are Prudes: Feels uncomfortable when the group go to a strip club. Girliness Upgrade: During one episode, Leah and Christina help her dress more girly and take her shopping for more feminine clothes. Hard-Drinking Party Girl: She says she loves to drink and party. Her drinking often gets her into trouble at times. The Ingenue: She is a virgin because she wants to wait for love before she has sex. Playing Sick: She and Simon pretend to be sick to get an extension on an assignment from work.

characters.name: Simone Sherry-Wood
characters.description: Camp Gay: He loves and works in fashion. Oireland: The only non-American roommate of the season, he speaks with a thick Irish accent. Out of Focus: Hardly had any screen time during the season, and didn't hang out with the roommates very much. Playing Sick: He and Mallory pretend to be sick to get an extension on an assignment from work. Twofer Token Minority: Even though he is white, he is the only gay roommate of the season, and the only non-American.
